description.value:
You inspire up to three creatures of your choice within range. Until the power ends, whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw, it can roll a d4 and add the result to the roll.

When cast using a force slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for every two slot levels above 1st, and the bonus die becomes a d6 at 3rd level, a d8 at 6th level, and a d10 at 9th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, Level 1
